purpose: Prevent accidental mixing of distinct forecast populations while preserving transparent calibration state.

API_AGENT_RATIFIED_T13.inclusion_rule: Only explicitly ratified prospective FROZEN_FORECAST_v1 records and their governed matured outcomes.

FRAMEWORK_MEMORY_BROAD.reason: This population is broader and does not currently satisfy the canonical model-calibration schema. It must not be silently repointed into MODEL_CALIBRATION_LEDGER.csv.

state_semantics.NO_FROZEN_RATIFIED_COHORT: No canonical ratified forecast cohort currently exists. An empty calibration ledger is expected and must be reported explicitly rather than presented as a healthy learned state.
state_semantics.COHORT_PRESENT_AWAITING_OUTCOMES: Ratified forecasts exist but no governed outcomes have matured yet.
state_semantics.COHORT_PRESENT_NO_SETTLEMENT_ELIGIBLE_OU: Governed outcomes exist but none are eligible for settlement-timing scoring.
state_semantics.SETTLEMENT_ELIGIBLE_ROWS_PRESENT: At least one governed outcome is settlement-eligible. This still does not create forecast-skill authority or model-weight authority.
